text: Aditya Birla Sun Life Insurance (ABSLI) India ka leading life insurance provider hai. ABSLI boasts a claim settlement ratio of 98.86% for individual business. Product portfolio me term insurance, savings plans, ULIPs, retirement/pension plans, child plans aur health plans shamil hain. Flexible premium payment modes aur frequency available hain. Premiums paid towards ABSLI policies are eligible for tax deductions under Section 80C (up to INR 1.5 lakh annually), aur death benefit tax-exempt hai under Section 10(10D) of the Income Tax Act, 1961.

Term life insurance: pure protection plan offering high coverage at low premiums. It pays the sum assured to the beneficiary in case of the policyholder demise during the term. No maturity benefit. Coverage should ideally be 10 to 15 times your annual income. Young policyholders lock in lower premiums for a lifetime. Most popular ABSLI term plans: ABSLI DigiShield Plan, ABSLI Salaried Term Plan, ABSLI Super Term Plan, ABSLI Poorna Suraksha Kawach, ABSLI Saral Jeevan Bima.

ABSLI life insurance riders (optional add-ons): ABSLI Accidental Death and Disability Rider, ABSLI Critical Illness Rider, ABSLI Surgical Care Rider, ABSLI Hospital Care Rider (daily cash + ICU benefits), ABSLI Waiver of Premium Rider (coverage continues if unable to pay due to disability/critical illness). Riders ke premiums qualify under Section 80C/80D tax deductions.

Life insurance key benefits: financial security for family (death benefit lump sum), debt protection (home loan, car loan cleared), wealth creation (endowment/ULIP savings component), tax benefits (Section 80C premium deduction up to INR 1.5 lakh, 10(10D) tax-free payouts), long-term coverage up to 40 years, peace of mind.

Most popular ABSLI savings/income plans: ABSLI Nishchit Aayush Plan (guaranteed income post-maturity + life cover), ABSLI Assured Savings Plan (guaranteed additions + life cover), ABSLI Assured Income Plus (guaranteed income + bonus accumulation), ABSLI Wealth Aspire ULIP (market-linked returns + life cover), ABSLI Guaranteed Annuity Plus (regular post-retirement income + return of purchase price).

text: Activ One NXT Health Insurance Plan from Aditya Birla Health Insurance (UIN: ADIHLIP24097V012324). Comprehensive health plan jo health aur financial well-being dono prioritize karta hai. Premium starting ₹5,630 per annum. Earn up to 100% HealthReturns by healthy habits (walking 10,000 steps daily or burning 300 calories a day) — HealthReturns use ho sakte hain premium payment ke liye. Free health assessment (BP, BMI, blood sugar, total cholesterol) included.

text: Activ One NXT Super Reload: 2X Sum Insured available from Day 1, unlimited refill up to 100% of base sum insured from 2nd claim onwards for all subsequent claims in a policy year. No capping on hospitalization expenses — room rent, ICU charges, modern treatments, HIV/AIDS cover, mental illness hospitalization, obesity treatment, organ donor expenses, domiciliary hospitalization, home health care, AYUSH treatment, road ambulance sab base sum insured tak actuals par covered hain.

text: Activ One NXT Super Credit (optional): renewal par har saal 100% of base sum insured added, maximum up to 500% of base sum insured ya INR 3 crore, irrespective of claims. Base Sum Insured options: 5 Lacs, 7 Lacs, 10 Lacs, 15 Lacs, 20 Lacs, 25 Lacs, 50 Lacs, 75 Lacs, 1 Crore, 2 Crores. Maximum sum insured available under Activ One NXT is INR 2 crores.

text: Activ One NXT eligibility: entry age adult minimum 18 years, maximum no capping; dependent child 91 days to 25 years (family floater/multi individual), individual child minimum 5 years. Policy types: individual aur family floater. Tenure: 1, 2, 3 years. Family definition: up to 2 adults, 4 children (self, spouse/live-in partner, children, parents, parents-in-law). Waiting period: initial 30 days (excluding accidental hospitalization), specific diseases 2 years, pre-existing diseases as per schedule. Medical tests may be required depending on age.
